description.text: The twelfth expansion of the Sword & Shield series, released on 21 October 2022, in which legendary Pokémon awaken on an unexplored island far away, where Pokémon lived quietly. Lugia VSTAR leads it: its VSTAR Power, the Ability Summoning Star, puts up to two Colorless Pokémon from the discard pile onto the Bench, and Archeops, whose Ability attaches up to two Special Energy from the deck, plays beside it. Unown VSTAR, whose VSTAR Power attack makes Psychic the Weakness of all the opponent's Pokémon, Regidrago VSTAR, which can use the attacks of Dragon Pokémon in its player's discard pile, and Regieleki VMAX join it, with Lance and two Pokémon Tools that give the Pokémon V holding them a VSTAR Power, Forest Seal Stone and Earthen Seal Stone. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 98, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, some Pokémon V in a second version drawn as a full scene, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VSTAR, Regieleki VMAX and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Lugia VSTAR, Leafy Camo Poncho and Gapejaw Bog. In English most of its cards came out in Silver Tempest in November 2022 and Crown Zenith in January 2023.
